requires.label: Patient must reside in Gunnison, Hinsdale, or Saguache County
requires.quote: GVH and FMC provide financial assistance to Gunnison, Hinsdale and Saguache County Residents

rules.label: Medical hardship discount for income above 400% FPL but below $200,000 with out-of-pocket obligations exceeding 20% of income
rules.quote: Patient, or patient's guarantor, has annual family income in excess of 400% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines, but less than $200,000, and Patient, or patient's guarantor, has exhausted all other payment options including private coverage, federal, state and local medical assistance programs, and other forms of assistance provided by third parties; and The out-of-pocket, patient obligations resulting from medical services provided by GVH and FMC providers exceed 20% of annual family income

rules.label: Presumptive eligibility for deceased patients with no estate
Presumptive eligibility for Medicaid eligible but not active for date of service (90-day lookback)
rules.quote: Medicaid eligible, but not active for a date of service. 90 days look back period

rules.label: Presumptive eligibility for mental incapacitation with no one to act on patient's behalf
rules.quote: Mental incapacitation: No one to act on patient's behalf

rules.label: Presumptive eligibility for patients eligible for out-of-state Medicaid where GVH/FMC do not participate
rules.quote: Patients are eligible for out-of-state Medicaid and GVH and FMC do not participate in the States Medicaid Program

rules.label: Billed charges capped at Amounts Generally Billed (AGB) for patients qualifying for financial assistance
rules.quote: If a patient qualifies for financial assistance under this policy, the patient's billed charges will be no more than the same amounts generally billed (AGB) for emergency or other medically necessary health care services as patients who have insurance coverage

payment_plan.quote: Reasonable Payment Plan: A payment plan that is negotiated between GVH and FMC and the guarantor for any balances owed. The payment plan shall consider the patient, or guarantor's income and assets, the amount owed and any prior payments

notes: Policy covers emergency and medically necessary services; non-urgent, elective, or not medically necessary services may be excluded or limited (cosmetic surgery, ophthalmology, integrative therapies, oncology specifically mentioned as non-covered).
Physical Therapy and Behavioral Health limited to six visits based on medical necessity; Behavioral Health not covered under CICP guidelines.
Duration of eligibility: 6 months from application date; covers eligible accounts for services received next 6 months or 90 days prior to completed application date.
Patients at or below 250% FPL who are Gunnison, Hinsdale, Saguache residents required to apply for Colorado Indigent Care Program (CICP).
Medicaid screening: accounts placed on 30-day hold pending Medicaid determination.
If patient/guarantor refuses to apply for or provide information necessary to application, may be ineligible for financial assistance.
Appeals: must be filed in writing within 30 days of FAP eligibility notice; Customer Service Supervisor responds in writing within 14 days.
Discount approval levels: Financial Counselor ($1-$5,000.99), Customer Service Supervisor ($1,001-$5,000.99), Revenue Cycle Director ($5,001-$10,000), CFO (>$10,000).
Payment expected in full within 30 days of new statement date after FAP discount posted.
AGB percentage is 71% of gross charges for inpatient and outpatient services.
Collection procedures: during 120-day notification period, at least three billing statements, seriously past due notice, and final notice; ECA only after final notice and 30 days elapsed.
Patients who qualify for financial assistance but fail to pay discounted balance when due considered uncollectible bad debts and referred to outside agencies.
Confidentiality maintained for all financial assistance applicants.
Application must be completed within 14 days per application form instructions; if information requested, patient/guarantor has 30 days to respond or application denied.
Eligibility determination made within 15 business days after completed application submission.
Policy prohibits discrimination based on race, color, creed, religion, gender, sexual orientation, citizenship, age, disability, or national origin.
rule-medical-hardship may leave out a condition: missing exhaustion of other payment options

findings.title: Covers everyone Colorado's Hospital Discounted Care protects

law.source: HCPF Hospital Discounted Care Operations Manual, Mar 31 2026
law.quote: Patients and their households are eligible for Hospital Discounted Care if, during the required screening and application processes, they are determined to: Have a total household income at or below 250% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines (FPG), and Be residents of the State of Colorado.
IF REQUESTED BY THE PATIENT, A HEALTH-CARE FACILITY SHALL SCREEN AN INSURED PATIENT FOR DISCOUNTED CARE

findings.summary: Proved for the encoded rules: every Colorado resident at or below 250% of the poverty line qualifies for help under this policy's written rules.
findings.domain: every household in the encoded domain: 1–12 people, income $0–$1M, assets $0–$10M, bill $0–$5M, first bill by day 400, every combination of the yes/no facts

findings.title: Ignores assets for Colorado-protected households

law.quote: THE METHODOLOGY MUST NOT CONSIDER A PATIENT'S ASSETS.

findings.summary: Proved for the encoded rules: for households Colorado's law protects, savings and assets never changes the outcome.
findings.domain: every household in the encoded domain: 1–12 people, income $0–$1M, assets $0–$10M, bill $0–$5M, first bill by day 400, every combination of the yes/no facts (pairs of households)

findings.domain: every household in the encoded domain: 1–12 people, income $0–$1M, assets $0–$10M, bill $0–$5M, first bill by day 400, every combination of the yes/no facts (pairs of households)
